title: Support & feedback
description: Report a problem, ask a question, or tell us what would make the app better.

form.title: Send a message
form.messagePlaceholder: What happened, and what were you trying to do?
form.referenceAttached: Error reference {{reference}} will be attached to this report.
form.privacyNote: We attach the page you were on, the app version and the error reference. We never send passwords, sign-in tokens or your customers' private records.
form.directContact: You can also reach support directly at {{contact}}.

sent.title: Thanks — we have it
sent.body: Your reference is {{reference}}. Keep it handy if you follow up.

errors.submit: We could not send that report. Please try again.
